message.content: {"caption":"Grouped bar chart comparing success rates for three methods, with and without failure data, against a no-memory reference.","description":"A grouped vertical bar chart has Success Rate on the y-axis, with labeled ticks from 35 to 50 in increments of 3; the axis starts at 35, not zero.
